verdict.rationale: The pack documents no batch or bulk-processing endpoint. The only support is indirect: high per-model concurrency limits (e.g. 2500), free capacity-expansion requests, and default context caching. Together these let a developer fan out many parallel API calls over many items, but the user must build that orchestration. Missing for 10: a native batch/bulk API, documented bulk job submission and result retrieval, and any independent or hands-on evidence of bulk workflows.
